documentInfo.description: Error: oimce:multipleAliasesForURI. The analytics module uses secondary prefix 'exp' for http://example.com/common, colliding with the importing model's 'exp' for http://example.com/financials. The importing model declares http://example.com/common under two aliases — 'cmn' and 'common' — making implicit resolution ambiguous. No prefixRemap is provided, so the processor MUST raise oimce:multipleAliasesForURI. See NAMESPACE-PrefixRemapAmbiguousExplicit-Valid.json for the resolved form.
